title: Power Pages: Power BI Embed Token v2 support for paginated reports and multi-report embedding
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, administrator paths, licensing prerequisites and qualified role guidance are supported. It correctly distinguishes the launched roadmap capability from Learn's conflicting token-version and paginated-report guidance, without inventing a version selector or migration behaviour.

claims.claim: The roadmap states that Power Pages now supports Power BI Embed Token v2.
claims.quote: Power Pages now supports Power BI Embed Token v2, unlocking modern Power BI embedding scenarios that weren't supported with Embed Token v1.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the new embedding scenarios as unsupported by Embed Token v1.
claims.quote: unlocking modern Power BI embedding scenarios that weren't supported with Embed Token v1.

claims.claim: The roadmap lists embedding paginated RDL reports.
claims.quote:
With Embed Token v2, Power Pages can embed:

- Paginated (RDL) reports

claims.claim: The roadmap includes paginated reports using Power BI datasets as a data source.
claims.quote: Paginated (RDL) reports, including reports that use Power BI datasets as a data source or require multi-resource tokens.

claims.claim: The roadmap includes paginated reports requiring multi-resource tokens.
claims.quote: Paginated (RDL) reports, including reports that use Power BI datasets as a data source or require multi-resource tokens.
